text:
zane: Observed a mismatch in the permissions console during the /v1/predict rollout. Console preview shows access allowed, but live auth denies for a service token when per-route deny + quota routing are combined. Repro on staging.
marta: Can you share the minimal steps?
zane: Create role `ingest-writer` with scope `dataset:events`, add per-route DENY for `/v1/predict` in tenant:enterprise-acme, enable route-level quota routing that moves requests to dedicated pool -> preview: allowed, live: denied.
rachel: That sounds like an ordering bug: preview evaluator flattens role bindings before applying route quota routing rules which can inject deny bindings during runtime. The auth-service applies routing-layer denies last.
zane: Timestamps: preview snapshot_rev=rev-20251205-0810 generated_at=2025-12-05T08:10:02Z; auth policy_rev=rev-20251205-0812.
marta: Two things: UX and backend. UX should surface a small "policy freshness" indicator and a "run live check" CTA. Backend should add a cheap compare endpoint (no full reconcile) and include X-Policy-Revision & X-Route-Quota-Hash headers on preview responses.
rachel: Implementation detail: add hashed routing fingerprint header `X-Route-Quota-Hash: h2f9a` so console can detect if routing rules differ too. If either header mismatches auth, show orange pill "policy/route mismatch".
zane: Also: telemetry. Emit metric `preview.discrepancy_rate{tenant}` and a histogram of discrepancy_age_seconds. Alert if > 0.3% in 1h by tenant.
marta: For canary rollouts we should gate console preview default to use the canary's snapshot if the tenant is in the canary group. If not, show a note "previewing stable policy". That reduces surprise during gradual rollouts.
rachel: Agree. Also propose a lightweight trace: `X-Policy-Trace-Id` header that points to an ephemeral explain stored in redis for 30m. The explain should show: binding_id -> role_id -> scope -> route_decision and note whether the decision came from routing-layer override.
devops-bot: Reconcile leader election: leader swapped at 1759001207; reconcile resumed at 1759001260.
zane: For the UI text: show last reconciled delta e.g. "Reconciled 2m ago" with tooltip "snapshot_rev rev-... vs live rev rev-..." and a CTA "Compare revisions" that calls the cheap compare. If compare reports inconsistent, show "Run live check" (rate-limited).
marta: Rate-limit idea: 10 live checks per user per 5 minutes across tenants; show cooldown progress bar.
rachel: Backend spec summary: 1) add headers X-Policy-Revision, X-Route-Quota-Hash, X-Policy-Trace-Id on /api/preview/effective responses; 2) add GET /api/preview/compare?tenant=.. returns json string "{\"snapshot_rev\":\"..\",\"policy_rev\":\"..\",\"route_hash\":\"..\",\"consistent\":true}"; 3) trace store in redis with TTL=1800s sampled writes; 4) telemetry counters and a per-tenant alert.
zane: Tests: add e2e that flips routing quota flag during reconcile and asserts preview indicates mismatch and trace eventually shows the route deny.
marta: I'll open PR for headers + UI pill first (low-risk). Rachel can drive trace storage and telemetry.
perm-bot: Permission cache invalidated for tenant:enterprise-acme at 1759001245 (auto).
zane: Assign tasks: marta -> header+UI pill PR + mock; rachel -> trace endpoint + telemetry + sample; zane -> e2e + monitoring dashboard panel.
marta: I'll aim to land pill PR by end of sprint.
rachel: I'll add Grafana panel `preview.discrepancy_rate` and a playbook snippet for on-call.
zane: One more: redact any principal identifiers in traces. Keep only role IDs, binding IDs, route IDs.
devops-bot: Reconcile caught up at 1759001310.
marta: Great. If reconcile catches up, the compare endpoint should return consistent=true. We'll still keep pill as guard.
zane: Thanks folks. Post PR links here when ready.
